interpretation: The formal classification is preserved exactly, but the comparison is not a valid physical restart-equivalence failure: the continuous arm ended at native time 0.10 while the restarted arm ended at 0.05. Inspection of the audit runner showed ntimemax was set to 5 on restart as though it were an additional-step count; native restart semantics require the absolute target step, so the resumed run did not advance to step 10. This is an audit-setup/pipeline defect, not evidence against native M3D-C1 restart handoff. Zero equivalence is NOT_APPLICABLE_SOURCE0_RESTART_CAPABILITY_TEST; frozen +0.020% width and +0.10% Jpk gates remain unchanged and no controller efficacy claim is made.
